_설명: 조선 사건사고 '위조지폐범' 편 인물 (2026-11-14). 자동 시트가 불합격(수령: 사모가 갓처럼·서양 허리띠 버클 / 노비: 옷에 한자·신발이 앞뒤 다름)이라 기본 시트를 기준으로 다시 그림

chars.name: 수령
chars.look: a Joseon county magistrate in his late 40s, stern square face, thin mustache and short black beard, wears a black samo official cap and a deep blue dallyeong official robe with a square crane rank badge, a stiff belt hanging loosely, black heukhwa boots, hands empty
chars.look_ko: 40대 후반 고을 수령, 엄한 네모 얼굴, 가는 콧수염과 짧은 검은 수염, 검은 사모, 짙은 파랑 단령(학 흉배), 느슨한 띠, 검은 목화

chars.name: 노비 위조범
chars.look: a thin Joseon male servant in his early 30s, gaunt narrow face, wary dark eyes, faint stubble, hair in a sangtu topknot with a black manggeon headband, plain faded white hemp jeogori jacket and loose baji trousers tied at the ankles, woven straw jipsin shoes, hands empty
chars.look_ko: 30대 초반 마른 남자 노비, 갸름한 얼굴, 경계하는 눈, 옅은 수염자국, 상투와 망건, 바랜 흰 삼베 저고리·바지(발목 대님), 짚신, 빈손

chars.name: 태종
chars.look: King Taejong of Joseon in his mid 30s, strong square jaw, sharp determined eyes, short black mustache and short beard, exactly the king's costume of the reference sheet: black ikseongwan cap, bright red gonryongpo robe with gold dragon badges, okdae jade belt, black boots
chars.look_ko: 30대 중반 태종, 각진 턱, 날카로운 눈, 짧은 콧수염·턱수염, 기본_왕 시트와 같은 익선관·붉은 곤룡포

chars.name: 세종
chars.look: King Sejong of Joseon in his late 20s, round gentle scholarly face, calm thoughtful eyes, slightly plump, thin mustache and small beard, exactly the king's costume of the reference sheet: black ikseongwan cap, bright red gonryongpo robe with gold dragon badges, okdae jade belt, black boots
chars.look_ko: 20대 후반 세종, 둥글고 온화한 얼굴, 차분한 눈, 약간 통통, 가는 콧수염, 기본_왕 시트와 같은 익선관·붉은 곤룡포

chars.name: 하륜
chars.look: Ha Ryun, a senior Joseon minister in his 50s, long thin white-streaked beard, shrewd narrow eyes, black samo official cap and a deep red dallyeong official robe with a square crane rank badge, black heukhwa boots
chars.look_ko: 50대 원로 대신 하륜, 희끗한 긴 수염, 영리한 가는 눈, 사모, 짙은 붉은 단령(학 흉배)

chars.name: 변계량
chars.look: Byeon Gye-ryang, a Joseon scholar-official in his 50s, thin face, gentle careful eyes, neat gray beard, black samo official cap and a deep blue-green dallyeong official robe with a square crane rank badge, black heukhwa boots
chars.look_ko: 50대 대제학 변계량, 마른 얼굴, 신중한 눈, 단정한 회색 수염, 사모, 청록 단령(학 흉배)

chars.name: 이계전
chars.look: Yi Gye-jeon, a young Joseon scholar of the Hall of Worthies in his 40s, earnest serious face, short black beard, black samo official cap and a green dallyeong official robe with a square crane rank badge, black heukhwa boots
chars.look_ko: 40대 집현전 학자 이계전, 진지한 얼굴, 짧은 검은 수염, 사모, 초록 단령(학 흉배)

chars.name: 쌀장수
chars.look: a Joseon rice merchant at the market in his 40s, round sunburned face, doubtful raised eyebrows, short beard, sangtu topknot with a black manggeon headband under a small round paeraengi bamboo hat, brown jeogori jacket and gray baji trousers, straw jipsin shoes, hands empty
chars.look_ko: 40대 시장 쌀장수, 둥근 그을린 얼굴, 의심스런 눈썹, 상투·망건 위 패랭이, 갈색 저고리·회색 바지, 짚신
